chapters.reason: The paper proposes SUPRA, a method to uptrain existing pre-trained transformers into RNNs with a modest compute budget, directly aligning with the description of converting fixed-architecture Transformers into hidden-state RNN models through targeted fine-tuning.

The paper focuses on linear transformers and recurrent models with fixed-size recurrent states, which are characteristic of linear-state recurrence using predetermined update rules, though the primary contribution is the conversion approach rather than a novel linear-state architecture.

The method involves specialized training (uptraining) to enable recurrent behavior in a standard transformer architecture, but it is more specifically a conversion technique (3.2.3) rather than purely training-induced recurrence without architectural changes.
